name: web3d-2026-starter
description: Modern realistic + interactive 3D site stack (August 2026): Vite 8 (Rolldown) + WebGPU + TSL + R3F v9 + drei + GSAP + Lenis + Motion + React Bits + Leva. See STACK.md.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run perf:check && npm run qa:state
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run qa:frames && npm run qa:shoot && npm run qa:diff

//verify: `npm run verify` è la definizione di FATTO: deterministico, headless, lanciabile sempre (lint + build + peso + gate di stato). `verify:full` aggiunge i gate che richiedono una GPU vera — frame time e pixel (shoot+diff) — ed è il gate di RILASCIO.
//versions: Latest stable pinned 6 Aug 2026. Node >=20.19 (Vite 8 engine). TypeScript is held at 6.x ON PURPOSE: 7.0 (Go-native, 8 Jul 2026) is out and ~10x faster, but typescript-eslint@8 declares `typescript <6.1.0` and the repo lints on every edit via a PostToolUse hook — revisit when typescript-eslint ships TS7 support (needs the stable programmatic API landing in TS 7.1).
//optional: Add per brief: @react-three/rapier + ecctrl (physics — Lanyard/Ballpit), @react-three/postprocessing (WebGL only; on WebGPU use three's node PostProcessing/RenderPipeline), @react-spring/three (spring 3D motion). KTX2: self-host the Basis transcoder from three/examples/jsm/libs/basis into public/basis/. React Bits components pull their own deps per component (gsap/motion/ogl/three) — install per use.
